title: Crafting the Perfect Short Cover Letter: Examples and Tips
description:
Struggling to get your cover letter to stand out? 

Are recruiters even reading them?? 

We're tackling the big questions about cover letters, with examples of how creating one can add value to your candidacy.

Long, boring cover letters are more likely to be skimmed over.

Recruiters want to see short, concise cover letters that get right to the point of your qualifications.

In this week's video we'll go over examples of how to showcase your experience on your cover letter that adds value.

Want examples of short cover letters? Check out 10 different ways to showcase your value: https://www.tealhq.com/post/short-cover-letter-examples/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_video&utm_campaign=resume_mistakes&utm_content=vid_description_1
